name: Yearly County-Level Stratified Counts
description: Annual county-level MBSF denominator beneficiary and death counts stratified by age group, sex, SSA race, RTI race and ethnicity, dual eligibility, HMO or Medicare Advantage enrollment, and buy-in coverage, with counts for total, Fee-for-Service, age-65-plus, Fee-for-Service age-65-plus, and disabled populations.

content.year: BIGINT: Calendar year of the data
content.sex: VARCHAR: Sex of the beneficiary. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female.
content.race: VARCHAR: SSA Beneficiary Race Code (Base). Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = White, 2 = Black, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = North American Native.
content.race_rti: VARCHAR: RTI-assigned enhanced race classification. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Non-Hispanic White, 2 = Black or African-American, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian/Pacific Islander, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = American Indian/Alaska Native.
content.dual: INTEGER: Dual eligibility status. Code values: 1 = dual eligible, 0 = not dual.
content.hmo: INTEGER: HMO enrollment status. Code values: 1 = enrolled in Medicare Advantage (HMO), 0 = not enrolled.
content.buyin: INTEGER: Buy-in status for Medicare A/B. Code values: 1 = any state buy-in months, 0 = none.
content.n_bene__total: BIGINT: Number of beneficiaries in the total population
content.n_bene__65plus: DOUBLE: Number of beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_bene__ffs65plus: DOUBLE: Number of Fee-for-Service beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_death__total: DOUBLE: Number of deaths in the total population
content.n_death__ffs: DOUBLE: Number of deaths among Fee-for-Service beneficiaries
content.n_death__65plus: DOUBLE: Number of deaths among beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_death__ffs65plus: DOUBLE: Number of deaths among Fee-for-Service beneficiaries age 65 or older
content.n_death__disabled: DOUBLE: Number of deaths among disabled beneficiaries
